risk_register.description: A unit error occurs where basis points and percentages are mixed in the same column without explicit labeling, leading to incorrect verdicts.
risk_register.mitigation: All columns must be labeled with explicit units (e.g., 'chargeback_ratio_percent', 'reserve_balance_basis_points'). Any cell mixing units is flagged and blocked from downstream processing.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Unit mismatch detected in raw extract parsing logs or during schema validation

risk_register.description: The computed verdicts diverge from the internal appetite statements due to misinterpretation of thresholds.
risk_register.mitigation: All verdict assignments must be cross-checked against appetite paragraphs. Any deviation requires override documentation with explicit paragraph reference and rationale.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Verdict in summary table differs from appetite threshold without override justification

risk_register.description: One or more portfolio segments are missing from the raw extracts, leading to incomplete analysis.
risk_register.mitigation: All 9 segments must be present in raw data. If any segment is missing, the process halts and flags it as a discovery item with full traceability to input source.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Missing segment ID detected during ingestion validation

risk_register.description: Incorrect bin range mapping leads to misclassification of decline curves, resulting in flawed risk assessments.
risk_register.mitigation: All bin ranges must be mapped using the defined scheme bin structure. Any deviation is flagged and requires manual review with source extract reference.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Bin range mapping does not align with extract-defined intervals in validation logs

notes: This artifact is scoped to the quarterly exposure review for card portfolio risk using only the supplied raw extracts. It does not include: (1) real-time monitoring of live transaction flows, (2) modeling of fraud rates beyond chargeback and decline data, or (3) forward-looking scenario analysis such as stress testing under economic shocks. These are outside the scope of this review cycle due to lack of input data and governance authority. The process is deterministic: all inputs are processed in order of segment ID (1–9), with no rounding applied beyond the raw extract precision. All numeric values are derived directly from supplied data or validated against appetite thresholds, and every verdict is explicitly tied to a defined rule or paragraph. Any input that cannot be classified (e.g., missing segment, malformed bin range) causes the process to halt with a diagnostic naming the offending input. The artifact is idempotent: re-running the same inputs produces identical outputs. All units are enforced in column labels; no basis-point/percentage values appear without explicit labeling. This artifact does not contain any glossary or terminology definitions outside of the fixed vocabulary used in the verdicts (within-appetite, watch, breach-imminent, breach). The review cadence is defined: Phase 1 validation reviewed by data governance team within 24 hours; Phase 2 computation reviewed by risk analysts on Day 5; override signoff completed by Day 15. Escalation paths are embedded in the decision log for any override requiring a higher authority, with information and timeframe specified.
